item.description:
Changes in v1.4.0

  • Lock Screen Music Widget: Apple Music styled widget with Liquid Glass on macOS lock screen (SkyLightOperator, level = Int32.max - 2, canBecomeVisibleWithoutLogin).
  • Audio Output Route Switcher: Interactive audio device selector supporting MacBook speakers, AirPods, and Bluetooth/AirPlay devices directly on lock screen.
  • Customizable Widget Sizing & Alignment: Added Compact, Standard, and Large sizing tiers, vertical offset slider, and left/center/right alignments.
  • Unified Settings UI: Standardized "Reset to Defaults" across fan control, appearance, and lock screen settings.
  • Lock Screen Event Handling: Redundant screen lock detection via DistributedNotificationCenter and NSWorkspace session notifications.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.3.2...v1.4.0
